changed_since_prior: County drought exposure around tracked campuses eased slightly; the movement does not alter the physical-buildout thesis.
All other thesis-bearing indicators were unchanged from the previous evaluation.
confirming_signals: Employee AI use remains concentrated in a few tasks and business functions.
Organizational adjustment still reaches a minority of AI-using businesses.
Funding coverage exceeds current spending while forward commitments remain several times larger.
Published campus capacity, planned generation, and interconnection queues remain project stocks awaiting operating conversion.
disconfirming_signals: Broader task and function deployment accompanied by widespread organizational adjustment.
Published campus capacity entering service with matched power delivery.
Real-compensation growth converging with productivity growth.
Forward commitments declining as projects enter current spending and operation.
analytical_state.thesis: AI use reaches employee tasks while the conversion bottleneck sits in workflow redesign and project operation; broader gains require commitments to become operating capacity, wider organizational adoption, and stronger compensation transmission.
unresolved_tensions: Forward commitments remain much larger than current capital spending.
Published campus capacity and planned generation still require operating conversion.
Employee use is visible while organizational adjustment and cross-function breadth remain limited.
Productivity growth continues to outpace real-compensation growth.

decision_reason: The thesis-bearing evidence is unchanged from the previous evaluation. Small movements in county drought exposure do not require a replacement domain Read or a new system interpretation.
